envelope.description: Give the control script one forced stop, used by its stop and its start

body.title: Give the control script one forced stop, used by its stop and its start
body.summary: Add one shell function that, after wait_for_daemon_stop fails, checks that the pid's command line ends in daemon/index.js, sends SIGKILL, waits for the process to be gone, removes the pid file and the socket and logs the 'killed' line; call it from cmd_stop and from the stale-daemon branch of cmd_start. A live pid that does not match is not killed and the script dies naming it. Add an environment override of the 30-second wait for the test.
acceptanceChecks: daemon-ctl.sh stop against a stubborn child kills it, removes the pid file and socket, exits 0 and logs the 'killed' line
daemon-ctl.sh start against a stubborn running child kills it through the same function and starts a new daemon
A live pid whose command line does not match is left alone and the script exits non-zero naming it
A stop of a healthy daemon behaves and exits as before

tests.name: control script stop against a stubborn child
control script start against a stubborn running child
control script leaves a live non-matching pid alone and exits non-zero
